scope: host-only actual Rust MSV1 receiver + ideal synthetic network, candidate single-frame reorder/XOR repair; not hardware

conditions.bursty: packet-step GE: good->bad 0.002, bad->good 0.25; per-state losses good 0.0005, bad 0.5
conditions.rate: constant L3 byte service shared by data and parity; no Wi-Fi MAC/PHY, audio or host/device timing
conditions.parity: one parity datagram per eight complete MSV1 datagrams, +24 assumed metadata bytes and IPv4/UDP; no negotiated implementation, auth, or ESP32 RAM timing
